item.description:

item.title: Dependency cooldowns turn you into a free-rider
item.description:
📝 All must implement dependency cooldowns. Upload queues have precedent. An upload queue separates package publication and package distribution.
🔗 Read more: https://calpaterson.com/deps.html

item.title: Not all elementary functions can be expressed with exp-minus-log
item.description:
📝 Since then, elementary functions have been defined by starting with rational functions and closing under arithmetic operations, composition, exponentiation, logarithms, and polynomial roots. Lemma: Every EML term has solvable monodromy group. Constants and coordinate functions have trivial monodromy.
🔗 Read more: https://www.stylewarning.com/posts/not-all-elementary/

item.title: Don't feel like exercising? Maybe it's the wrong time of day for you
item.description:
📝 Early risers or "larks" should exercise in the morning for maximum benefit, while night owls should train in the evening, they suggest. Night owls can be at greater risk of this, they add, meaning they shouldn't force early morning exercise routines. How to exercise safely with injuriesFuel your exercise routine like a pro with this handy toolSleepExerciseHealthFitnessHeart disease.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cd6lzpxwx50o
